{{av}}

The school of Wizardry allows dwarves to become arcane dwarves, research the various magical alters and make a variety of items equipped by the different types of magical dwarves available and used in the reactions themselves.

==Building Requirements==
Found in the Furnaces section it requires "Conduct research in the field of Magika" to be completed successfully at the [[Researcher's study | Researcher's Study]], 4 blocks, and 4 thrones.
{{clear}}
